name: spoke-package-tracker
description: Track a package from its tracking code and follow it on spokepackagetracker.com.

interface.longDescription:
Package Tracker finds where your package is from its tracking code. It works with 1,600+ couriers, including UPS, USPS, FedEx, DHL and Royal Mail.

Paste a tracking number and the courier is detected for you. You get the current status, courier, shipping and expected delivery dates, and the full event history, plus a link to follow the package on spokepackagetracker.com.

Not sure who shipped it? Ask which courier a tracking code belongs to. When a code could come from several couriers, you pick the right one. Some couriers also need the destination postal code or country, and you'll be asked for them.

No account needed.

Limitations: one package at a time, up to 10 lookups a day. Delivery notifications and bulk tracking aren't supported. Statuses and dates come from the courier and may be missing or delayed.
capabilities: Track a package from its tracking code
Identify which courier issued a tracking code
Link to the package on spokepackagetracker.com
defaultPrompt: Track this tracking number for me
Which courier does this tracking code belong to?

positive.description: Track a package whose courier is detected from the code
positive.prompt: Where is my package? The tracking number is 9234690381404001138978.
positive.expected_behavior: Detects USPS from the code and tracks the package. Replies with the returned status, courier, dates and recent events, without inventing a delivery date when one is missing, and shares the spokepackagetracker.com link.

positive.description: Ask the user to choose when several couriers match the code
positive.prompt: Can you track ZZ000000000ZZ for me?
positive.expected_behavior: The first call returns candidate couriers without tracking. Lists them and asks which courier shipped the package, without picking one. After the reviewer names a courier, calls track_package again with its carrierId. Since the code isn't a real shipment, says that courier has no information for it and asks the reviewer to check the code, without inventing a status, and shares the spokepackagetracker.com link.

positive.description: Track an international shipment from a courier the user names
positive.expected_behavior: Tracks the package with DHL Express and reports it as delivered, with the route from the United States to Germany taken from the returned events. Doesn't invent a delivery date or ask for details the courier didn't need, and shares the spokepackagetracker.com link.

positive.description: Identify the courier without tracking the package
positive.prompt: Which courier does the tracking code 1Z999AA10123456784 belong to?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the matching courier (UPS) by name and doesn't look up the package's status.

positive.description: Ask the user to check a code the courier doesn't know
positive.expected_behavior: Says UPS has no information for this code and asks the reviewer to check it, or try again later if it was only just sent. Doesn't try variations of the code or invent a status, location or delivery date. Shares the spokepackagetracker.com link.

negative.description: Doesn't compare shipping prices, which the plugin doesn't support
negative.prompt: What's the cheapest way to ship a 2 kg box from London to Paris?

negative.description: Doesn't file claims for lost packages, which the plugin doesn't support
negative.prompt: My USPS package never arrived. How do I file a claim for it?

negative.description: Doesn't buy shipping labels or book pickups, which the plugin doesn't support
negative.prompt: Book a FedEx pickup for my parcel tomorrow morning.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: track a package from its tracking code across 1,600+ couriers, identify a code's courier, and follow the package on spokepackagetracker.com.
